title: Ropes and Bricks
statement:
You walk along `n` towers with heights `h_0 ... h_{n-1}`, starting on tower `0`. To step from tower `i` to tower `i + 1`:

- if `h_{i+1} <= h_i`, you just walk;
- otherwise the climb is `h_{i+1} - h_i`, and you either spend that many bricks, or use one rope (a rope covers a climb of any size).

You own `b` bricks and `r` ropes. Print the index of the farthest tower you can reach.

## Input
The first line contains `n`, `b` and `r`. The second line contains `h_0 ... h_{n-1}`.

## Output
Print the largest reachable index.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 16000`
- `0 <= b <= 2 * 10^13`
- `0 <= r <= n`
- `1 <= h_i <= 10^9`
